info.title: Third-party monitoring fusion API
info.description: Proposed API for the custom fusion service, not an API specification for HertzBeat or SkyWalking. No live integration has been verified. All requests require server-side asset authorization. Times use RFC 3339 with timezone and are normalized to UTC. Partial upstream failures return explicit source status; absent measurements must not become zero. Examples, if later added, must be clearly labeled synthetic.

type.description: service_instance is one running replica of a service; it is a first-class asset so multi-replica latency can be attributed to a single pod/process.

parentAssetId.description: Structural parent: a service_instance points at its service; a container points at the host that runs it. Null for root assets. Must not encode runtime-only relationships.

MetricQuery.description: At most 10 assets x 20 metrics = 200 combinations, matching MetricQueryResponse.series maxItems so a valid request is never silently truncated. Requested points per series are rangeSeconds / stepSeconds; the server must reject the request with RANGE_TOO_DENSE when that exceeds maxPoints rather than silently downsampling. Fine-grained queries default to at most 6 hours. Larger ranges require verified rollup support. Unsupported combinations return explicit quality, not zero.

combinationsRequested.description: assetIds x metricIds of the request. Equal to series length when no combination was dropped; a smaller series length means the response was capped and truncated must be true.

truncated.description: True only when series had to be capped. Clients must surface this instead of assuming full coverage.

requestRate.description: Requests per second; null if unsupported.

EndpointsResponse.description: Sort/filter/pagination are available only if the verified upstream capability supports them.

startTime.description: RFC 3339 with timezone; normalized to UTC.

segmentId.description: Upstream segment/scope identifier. Required for addressing spans, because spanId is only unique inside a segment in some providers (for example SkyWalking).

parentSpanId.description: Null when this span is a root or when the provider cannot express the relation.

parentSegmentId.description: Segment owning parentSpanId. Differs from segmentId for cross-thread and cross-process parent links; together they form the resolvable parent key (parentSegmentId, parentSpanId).

serviceInstanceId.description: Asset id of type service_instance when the replica is known; null otherwise. Never inferred from a service-level aggregate.

component.description: Normalized component/plugin id, for example springmvc, jdbc, mariadb, httpclient. Used by correlation rules instead of parsing attribute strings.

peer.description: Normalized peer target for client spans: host:port, or a database/cluster name when the provider reports one. This is the join key for service-to-database correlation.

layer.description: Upstream layer when exposed, for example HTTP, RPC, DB, MQ.

startTime.description: RFC 3339 with timezone; normalized to UTC.

attributes.description: Allowlisted and redacted attributes only. Free-form attributes must not be the sole source of topology or correlation.

TraceListResponse.description: Contains stored samples, not necessarily all requests. No unsupported full-data extrapolation.
